bignews.title: Bucky Barnes and Yelena Belova debut at Avengers Campus
bignews.body: Winter Soldier and Yelena Belova are now meeting guests at Avengers Campus in Disney California Adventure as part of the leadup to Avengers: Doomsday, which opens in theaters December 18. The two characters join other Marvel heroes in interactive experiences tied to the new film.

parkioInsight.text: Character lines for new debuts tend to run longest mid-morning through early afternoon. Visiting Avengers Campus within the first hour after park opening or during the final two hours often shortens your wait significantly.

bignews.title: Doctor Doom popcorn bucket and Avengers-themed food arrive at Disney parks
bignews.body: A new Doctor Doom throne popcorn bucket is being sold alongside specialty food items at Disneyland Resort and other Disney parks worldwide to celebrate Avengers: Doomsday's December release. The offerings include villain-inspired dishes and hero-themed snacks across multiple locations.

parkioInsight.text: Limited-edition popcorn buckets tied to major film releases usually sell out at flagship locations by mid-afternoon. Heading to popcorn carts near Hollywood Land or Avengers Campus right at park open gives you the best shot at securing one.

bignews.title: Hexed movie tie-ins launch at Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World
bignews.body: Disney's Hexed, opening in theaters today, is being celebrated with themed experiences at both Disneyland Resort and Walt Disney World. Merchandise, beauty products, and event activations tied to the new film are now available across both coasts.

parkioInsight.text: Film-tied merchandise tends to draw the heaviest foot traffic at Emporium-style flagship shops during midday. Shopping within the first ninety minutes after opening or after 7pm typically means lighter crowds and fuller shelves.

topstories.title: New character debuts at Hollywood Studios
topstories.body: A brand-new character has started meeting guests at Disney's Hollywood Studios this week, though specifics on the character's identity and location have not been detailed. The addition expands the park's existing character lineup.

parkioInsight.text: Newly introduced character meets often see the longest waits during their first few days. If you're planning to meet this character, arriving at the location shortly after park open usually keeps your wait under 20 minutes.

topstories.title: Popular EPCOT attraction receives new overlay
topstories.body: A ride change has been implemented on one of EPCOT's most popular attractions this week. Details on the nature of the overlay and which ride is affected remain limited.

parkioInsight.text: Overlays on headliner attractions typically spark curiosity and longer waits during the first week. Riding during Early Entry or in the final hour before park close often yields shorter lines as the novelty settles.

topstories.title: Santa Goofy returns to EPCOT's Odyssey for Festival of the Holidays
topstories.body: The Odyssey pavilion is preparing for Santa Goofy's return during EPCOT's 2026 Festival of the Holidays. The character meet-and-greet location is being readied for guests visiting the park this holiday season.

parkioInsight.text: Holiday character meets at EPCOT tend to see the lightest crowds during World Showcase's early morning hours and during evening performances of Luminous. Visiting the Odyssey before 11am or after 7pm usually means shorter waits.

topstories.title: Magic Kingdom files new construction permit for Frontierland's Golden Oak Outpost
topstories.body: Walt Disney World has submitted a permit to install signage at Golden Oak Outpost in Frontierland, days after filing for general construction at nearby Pecos Bill. The filings suggest continued changes across the Magic Kingdom land.

parkioInsight.text: Construction activity near quick-service dining locations often creates noise and congestion during peak lunch hours. If you're planning to eat in Frontierland, aiming for an early or late dining window typically avoids the heaviest work.

topstories.title: Second construction permit filed for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance
topstories.body: Disney has submitted another construction permit for Star Wars: Rise of the Resistance at Hollywood Studios. The filing follows ongoing maintenance work on the attraction, though the scope of the latest permit has not been disclosed.

parkioInsight.text: Permit activity often precedes brief closures or maintenance windows. If Rise of the Resistance is a must-do, checking the app the morning of your visit and having a backup plan for Galaxy's Edge helps avoid disappointment.

topstories.title: EPCOT files twelve new construction permits
topstories.body: Walt Disney World has submitted a dozen construction permits for EPCOT, signaling additional changes on the horizon for the park. The filings follow years of transformation that have included new attractions and the removal of older pavilions.

parkioInsight.text: Construction zones at EPCOT have historically created the most noise and congestion in Future World during mid-morning through early afternoon. Planning quieter activities or World Showcase touring during those hours tends to reduce the impact.

topstories.title: New solar-powered trash cans installed near Tower of Terror raise theming concerns
topstories.body: Walt Disney World has placed new solar-powered compacting trash receptacles around its parks and hotels, including near the Tower of Terror at Hollywood Studios. Some guests have noted the modern waste bins clash with the attraction's 1930s theming.

parkioInsight.text: Theming inconsistencies rarely affect attraction operations but can detract from photo opportunities. Framing your Tower of Terror shots from the queue entrance or courtyard fountain typically avoids the new receptacles in the background.

icymi.title: Disney and Formula 1 extend partnership for 2026 race season
icymi.body: Mickey and Friends are returning to Formula 1 events throughout 2026 as part of a multi-year Fuel the Magic collaboration. The partnership, which debuted at the Las Vegas Grand Prix in 2025, continues this season with track-side appearances and activations.

icymi.title: 10% cash back on Disney gift cards offered for Black Friday
icymi.body: A Black Friday promotion is offering 10% back on Disney gift card purchases, adding to deals already available at Sam's Club, Target, and Best Buy. The offer provides another savings opportunity for guests planning park visits or purchases.

icymi.title: Disney appears in 100th Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade
icymi.body: Disney floats and balloons are part of today's Macy's Thanksgiving Day Parade in New York, marking the 100th edition of the annual event. The appearance continues a 90-year tradition of Disney participation in the holiday parade.

spotlight.title: Best value snacks for 2027 Disney Dining Plan revealed
spotlight.body: With the Disney Dining Plan returning for 2027 reservations, a new guide highlights which snacks deliver the strongest value per credit. The list covers both Walt Disney World and Disneyland Resort, helping guests maximize their prepaid meal entitlements across quick-service and specialty kiosks.

parkioInsight.text: High-value snack credits tend to be pastries, specialty ice cream treats, and fruit cups priced above six dollars. Redeeming credits on these items rather than bottled drinks or popcorn often saves you ten to fifteen dollars per day across a typical park visit.
